composition: An observation and initial state enter a horizontal three-block update loop. A broad curved return arrow runs below the update blocks. The final estimate sits to the right.

sources.s1: At inference, start from the supplied initial state s_0 and a fixed observation y.
sources.s2: The update block consumes y and the current state s_t and produces the next state s_(t+1).
sources.s3: Return s_(t+1) to the state register as the current state for the next iteration. After K updates, return the last state as the estimate.

zones.visual: Two vertically separated tiles containing the given observation and initial state.
zones.label: l_inputs

zones.visual: Three horizontal blocks with a wide empty lower gutter reserved for the return arrow.
zones.label: l_loop

nodes.visual: A compact fixed 3 by 3 grid; decorative cells, no asserted observation dimension.
nodes.label: l_y

nodes.visual: Three offset horizontal sheets; an initial-state glyph.
nodes.label: l_s0

nodes.visual: A rectangular register containing a short row of three cells.
nodes.label: l_state

nodes.visual: A plain computation block with two small input ports on the top and left; no invented internal algorithm.
nodes.label: l_update

nodes.visual: A rectangular state tile containing a short row of three cells.
nodes.label: l_candidate

nodes.visual: One state tile with the same three-cell glyph as the current-state tile.
nodes.label: l_estimate
